source.sample: GeckoTerminal pool listings for BNB Chain: /dexes/pancakeswap_v2/pools (sort h24_tx_count_desc, h24_volume_usd_desc), /pools (sort h24_tx_count_desc) and /trending_pools, pages 1-10 each; WBNB-quoted pools created inside the age window
source.candles: CoinMarketCap GET /v1/k-line/candles (platform=bsc, token address, interval 1d, unit native: BNB per token)
notes: CoinMarketCap /v1/dex/new/list is not on this key's plan (403, error 1006), so the sample comes from GeckoTerminal and the daily candles from CoinMarketCap.
Survivorship bias: the listings rank pools by current activity, so tokens that died quietly are under-sampled. The trigger share is therefore a conservative estimate for launches in general.
Days with no trades are filled with the previous close. A pool whose liquidity was pulled shows no candles after that, so a rug after launch can be missed.
1 of 27 sampled pools failed to return candles and are excluded.

terms.priceProxy: daily (open + high + low + close) / 4 in BNB, as a stand-in for the time-weighted pool price

headline.text: 4 of 26 actively traded BNB Chain launches (15.4%) would have opened a Covenant exit round, a median 9 days after launch, with 74% of the raise still in the treasury for holders.

variants.description: Original rule: 3 consecutive days below the floor; one day at or above resets the streak to zero.
Fixed rule (decay): a day below adds one, a day at or above subtracts one instead of resetting; opens at 3.
Fixed rule (72h average): the 3-day average price is below the floor.
